public_payload.normalized_proposition: Every Magnificent Seven company building AI data centers is losing money on it, with revenues too poor to disclose.

statement.excerpt: NVIDIA is the largest company on the US stock market and has sold hundreds of billions of dollars of GPUs in the last few years, with many of them sold to the Magnificent Seven, who are building massive data centers and reopening nuclear power plants to power them, and every single one of them is losing money doing so, with revenues so putrid they refuse to talk about them!

from_speaker: every single one of them is losing money doing so
revenues so putrid they refuse to talk about them
our_interpretation: Assess the supplied normalized proposition about AI operations and disclosure. The opening NVIDIA market-ranking and GPU-sales statements are outside that proposition.
The plain reading concerns losses attributable to AI infrastructure and services, rather than losses across the companies as a whole.
Use October–December 2025, the latest completed quarter ordinarily reportable before the April 8 post, for the ongoing financial assertion.
The relevant population is the Magnificent Seven members undertaking the described buildout; the sentence does not clearly identify every included company.
Losing money does not specify operating loss, net loss, negative cash flow or cumulative investment return. No cited accounting source establishes a basis, so accounting_basis is unknown.
Interpret refusal to discuss revenue as a disclosure assertion. Selected AI metrics can challenge that assertion without proving profitability or explaining management's motives.
criteria.support_condition: Comparable AI-specific financial records establish losses for every included company during the target quarter, and disclosure records support the claim that poor revenue caused the asserted silence.
criteria.contradiction_condition: Matching AI-specific accounts establish that at least one included company was not loss-making, or contemporaneous records refute the claimed refusal to discuss AI revenue. A definitive monetary verdict additionally requires a specified accounting basis.

Microsoft had explicitly disclosed an AI revenue run rate well before the post. This earlier announcement is context for the disclosure assertion, not realized quarterly revenue or evidence of AI profitability.

evidence.explanation: The broader Intelligent Cloud segment had a positive operating margin while absorbing AI investment. That cannot establish the profitability of AI alone, and declining margins do not themselves establish losses.

public_payload.what_would_resolve: A defined set of companies and accounting measure, followed by comparable AI-specific revenue and cost records for the target quarter. Claims about disclosure motives would require separate evidence.
